content_security_policy._comment: wasm-unsafe-eval required for TLDraw/Whisper WASM. No JS eval() is used anywhere. style-src unsafe-inline required for Shadow DOM component libraries. connect-src permits https: because users connect their OWN MCP servers and a static allowlist cannot name a host chosen after build time — that is why every MCP server except the hardcoded one silently failed. Network access is still gated: each origin must be granted at runtime via chrome.permissions.request() when the server is added in Settings, so the user approves it in Chrome's own dialog. That is per-host user consent rather than a build-time list they cannot influence. Third-party API keys remain server-side only (constraint #2).
